$comment: The role recruitment pages, one per role button, in this order (the comparison section on every page, and the home page's roles, list them all). Each page's copy is in content/roles/<slug>.json. Unlisted drafts (noindex) until the board approves the roles; see design/research/recognition-system.md. /ambassador/ is the Ambassador program page. Every path starts with the same free Upskilling account (OLOS manages everything centrally), so every role's button goes to account creation, with the role as ?path=<slug> for OLOS to pick up after sign-in (proposed; OLOS doesn't read it yet).
